title: knautia hybrida var. integrifolia
intro: Knautia hybrida var. integrifolia, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Caprifoliaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various conditions such as gastrointestinal disorders, respiratory issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Knautia hybrida var. integrifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
